title: The Righteousness of God
definition: The righteousness of God means that God is perfectly right in His character, actions, promises, and judgments.
summary: God is the standard of what is right. Everything He does is consistent with His holy nature.
christFocus: Christ's righteousness is credited to believers through faith, giving sinners a right standing before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is the standard of what is right. Everything He does is consistent with His holy nature.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
